rationale: The raw schedule localizes the flag to four ACI Group Holdings debt rows at table 19, rows 31-34. Rows 31-33 carry both footnote marker (12) and an asterisk, while row 34 carries (12) without an asterisk. Targeted raw-source searches found no legend defining either marker and no explicit nonaccrual wording. The schedule therefore does not decide whether (12), the asterisk, or their combination denotes nonaccrual, so the four-position flag cannot be confirmed or rejected without guessing.
